description: Aggregate runtime statistics for Fig. 3A (Results S3.3), computed from the per-batch run_summary.json files tracked alongside this file (raw per-sequence LinRacc stdout/output/logs are gitignored; regenerable from software.lock.json's pinned revision). elapsed_sec here includes benchmark/scripts/run_bprna_chunk.py's own output-validation and SHA-256 hashing overhead, not just the LinRacc binary invocation; see benchmark/results/matched_runtime_comparison_20260919 for an executable-only, matched-K comparison against Raccess Window.
